billing.title: Billing settings
billing.bankHint: Auto-shown on subscription invoices and payment notification emails. Admin marks paid after receiving transfer to activate.
billing.policyHint: Defaults for invoice issuance. Per-workspace overrides allowed.
billing.bankEnHint: For English-speaking customers / overseas wires (optional). If set, shown automatically on English screens and emails; otherwise falls back to Korean.
billing.stripeHint: The "Pay by card" button turns on only when both the Secret Key and the Webhook Secret are set — without the webhook, a paid subscription would never activate. Both are stored encrypted and never shown again.
billing.stripeWebhookHint: In the Stripe Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks, add the endpoint https://planq.kr/api/stripe/webhook (checkout.session.completed, payment_intent.succeeded), then paste its Signing secret here.
billing.secretKeepPh: Enter a new value to change (leave blank to keep)
billing.bankOn: Active — subscription is activated once an admin confirms the deposit
billing.bankOff: Off — fill in bank name, account number and holder to turn it on
billing.cardOn: Active — subscription activates immediately on successful payment
billing.cardOff: Off — add {{missing}} to turn it on
billing.encMismatch: The keys are stored but the server could not decrypt them. EMAIL_ENCRYPTION_KEY may have changed — please re-enter the Secret Key and Webhook Secret.
billing.stripeHint2: Add the two values below to enable the "Pay by card" button on the subscription checkout. Both are stored encrypted and never shown again.
billing.whereSecret: Stripe Dashboard → Developers → API keys, then click "Reveal" to copy
billing.whereWebhook: Stripe Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks: add the URL below as an endpoint, then copy the generated Signing secret
billing.publishableUnused: Payments run through Stripe-hosted checkout, so this value is not used. Card payment works without it.
billing.storedMalformed: The stored value "{{value}}" is not a Stripe key. Replace it with a value starting with pk_, or clear it.

subs.title: Subscriptions
subs.emptyDesc: Try a different filter or search.
subs.confirmPayMsg: Mark the pending payment for {{biz}} as paid. This will activate the subscription.
subs.confirmDemoteMsg: Demote {{biz}} to Free plan. Data is preserved.
subs.exemptNotice: {{n}} billing-exempt workspace(s) are excluded from the overdue / grace / downgraded counts. Change exemptions in Workspace management.

platform.title: Platform settings
platform.hint: PlanQ operator information. Used in email footer, legal notices, and support contact. Changes auto-save; emails reflect updates after a 5-minute cache.
platform.email_logo_hint: Leave blank for default logo (inline cid attachment)

page.title: Workspace Admin
page.desc: Platform-admin only — manual plan adjustment, trial extension, and change history.

changePlan.title: Manual plan change
changePlan.desc: Temporary adjustment before payment integration. Applies immediately and is logged in history.
changePlan.expiresHelp: If set, auto-downgrade to Free on that date. Leave blank to keep existing.
changePlan.notePlaceholder: e.g. Promo free upgrade for 1 month

trial.title: Trial settings
trial.desc: Set a trial end date. The workspace stays in Trial state until then.

exempt.title: Billing exemption
exempt.desc: While exempt, subscription charges, grace periods, and downgrades all stop, and this workspace’s payments are excluded from revenue.
exempt.untilHelp: After this date the workspace returns to normal billing automatically.
exempt.notePlaceholder: e.g. Our internal workspace / tester customer

empty.title: No email logs
empty.message: All emails sent by the system will appear here.

credit.desc: When credit runs out, that feature stops. Platform admins are emailed as the remaining days fall (30/14/7/3/1).
credit.hint: Enter the new balance after topping up to keep the estimate accurate. From the second entry on, the real rate is calculated automatically.
credit.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again shortly.
credit.invalidBalance: Enter the balance as a number.
credit.learned: Learned the real rate — {{m}} min used, ${{u}} charged → ${{r}}/min
